title: Reduction to nonnegative functions
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p,q,\rho$ be real numbers with $p>0$, $q>0$, and $-1\leq\rho\leq1$, and suppose that for every pointwise nonnegative function $g:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, the noise operator with parameter $\rho$ satisfies $\|T_\rho g\|_q\leq\|g\|_p$. Then the same inequality holds for every real-valued function $f$ on $\{\pm1\}^n$.
hypotheses_covered: The stated norm inequality holds for every pointwise nonnegative $g:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb R$
